title: Net Neutrality
definition: Net neutrality is the principle that Internet Service Providers (ISPs) must treat all data on the internet equally, without discriminating, throttling, or charging differentially by user, content, website, platform, application, or mode of communication.
importanceInUpsc: Tested rigorously in Prelims (regulatory bodies like TRAI, technical mechanisms) and Mains GS-3 (Science & Technology - infrastructure, cyber security, digital economy, and socio-economic equality).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Net Neutrality.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of telecommunications and IP networks
